unserved-os-face.policy: Use the specified served stack. A cluster outside it paints a question mark in Geist.

cjk-punctuation-trim.policy: Apply contextual halt and chws without fitting a closer by trimming the line end.

space-after-emoji-or-rtl.policy: Hang trailing spaces on the preceding line, including after emoji and RTL words.

url-and-slash-breaks.policy: Keep HTTP URLs together and permit overflow.

break-before-ellipsis.policy: Keep ICU line breaks, including no break before infix punctuation.

different-served-face.policy: Use the served emoji face for color presentation and for keycaps.

line-edge-shaping.policy: Shape each chosen line again in HarfBuzz with its own context.
